current_binding_status: UNBOUND: final_A_tree after hygiene, last_tested_A_tree with its actual full artifact receipt, their independent source-relation review, current full metadata, complete helper basename roster, paths, ordinary-index SHA and actual free bytes must be supplied after A finishes.

cargo_target.freshness: Every scope performs the original normal-helper builds and full-workspace catalogue against its current source; actual postcatalog test/helper bytes are independently recorded before and after each run. A retained directory is not retained qualification.

limits: Earlier f825 receipt, not the current final A target or graph.
Measures selected executable file sizes, not all target files or peak allocated filesystem blocks.
No current native filesystem inspection was made for this static estimate.

illustrative_initial_allowances.basis: One additional complete observed executable family allows for registry-to-local-driver identity changes. Cargo objects/rlibs, Bazel and evidence amounts are explicitly unmeasured planning allowances, not proven maxima.

reported_available_space.qualification: Conditional only; unit precision and final A growth are unknown. The runner uses actual integer free bytes and actual final-A artifact sizes before launch.

same_filesystem_required_for: private B cache or its parent
enforcement.before_launch: Use pinned last-tested-A full-workspace artifact receipt under its true source identity; bind reviewed relationship to final_A_tree. Sum unique executable sizes and require actual free >= reviewed remaining-growth plan + 8,000,000,000-byte reserve.
enforcement.between_epochs: Keep exact target/cache/owner/last-tested-A receipt/helper roster and final-A relation-review continuity; root may separately review the remaining-growth estimate after each completed epoch.
enforcement.if_insufficient: Stop. Do not delete A/shared/B caches, weaken scopes, switch profiles or alter test timeouts. Capacity expansion or a revised supported estimate requires a concrete review.

tested_vs_final_A.last_tested_A_tree: Actual source of the prior complete test/catalogue artifact receipt, even if final hygiene changes source.
tested_vs_final_A.relation: Root must bind an independent source-relation review; no relabeling of tested binaries or old receipts.
tested_vs_final_A.B_compilation: Each phase actually rebuilds helpers/catalogue and hashes its current programs.
